newsitem.title: USA: Santa Barbara Bank agrees to merger.
newsitem.headline: Santa Barbara Bank agrees to merger.

text.p: Santa Barbara Bancorp said on Thursday it agreed to merge with First Valley Bank, Lompoc.
The agreement provides for First Valley Bank shareholders to receive $58 in cash for each of the 450,000 First Valley Bank shares outstanding.
The transaction, valued at $26.1 million, represents 1.7 times First Valley's estimated book value at closing and 16.3 times estimated 1996 earnings.
The merger is anticipated to close at the end of the first quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory approval and the approval of First Valley Bank shareholders.
